entry.title: New: dsh-ops-health
entry.summary: One-click health check for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar button runs the ops kit's check-health.ps1 through a plain HTTP route (independent of the tool registry) and renders a structured report card; colors follow the active theme, Windows/PowerShell. Exact install spec: github:miraculousgarfield/dsh-ops-health. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
